description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the Acknowledgements interface, managing a collection of acknowledgement objects, their associated entity information, HTTP status code, and headers. It provides methods for creating instances, querying acknowledgements by status or label, serializing to JSON, and handling headers.

classes.name: ImmutableAcknowledgements
classes.description: A final, immutable class implementing the Acknowledgements interface, encapsulating entity ID, list of acknowledgements, HTTP status code, and headers. Provides factory methods, JSON serialization, and accessors for acknowledgement data.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableAcknowledgements instance from a collection of acknowledgements and headers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableAcknowledgements instance with specified entity ID, acknowledgements, status code, and headers.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns an empty acknowledgements object for the specified entity ID and headers.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the combined HTTP status code for these acknowledgements.

methods.name: getMissingAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Returns labels of acknowledgements that are timeout acknowledgements.

methods.name: getSuccessfulAcknowledgements
methods.description: Returns acknowledgements that are successful.

methods.name: getFailedAcknowledgements
methods.description: Returns acknowledgements that failed.

methods.name: getAcknowledgement
methods.description: Retrieves an acknowledgment by its label.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the acknowledgements.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of acknowledgements.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are any acknowledgements.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a stream of acknowledgements.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with these acknowledgements.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified headers.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with the acknowledgements.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string type identifier for acknowledgements.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Provides the entity data as JSON, depending on acknowledged data and schema version.

methods.name: acknowledgementsEntitiesToJson
methods.description: Converts all acknowledgements to a JSON object with disambiguation based on labels.

methods.name: buildHeadersJson
methods.description: Creates JSON representation of headers, specially handling ContentType headers.

methods.name: acknowledgementsToJsonWithDisambiguation
methods.description: Exports acknowledgements to JSON, grouping by labels into arrays for disambiguation.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes this acknowledgements object to JSON with the given schema version and predicate.
